question: How does Maya delude those seeking liberation?
premises: Maya indeed deludes them in non-liberation
this occurs by desire for liberation
Vaishnava and others join Shaiva scripture to their own teaching
inference: desire for liberation can be exploited by Maya and sectarian appropriation
uncertainties: vaiṣṇavādiḥ may be plural in sense
plain_english: Maya indeed deludes them in non-liberation, by desire for liberation; Vaishnava and others join Shaiva scripture to their own teaching.
